goldkoi.rumor: Old Wen swears a golden koi surfaces in the big pond when the rain comes in at dawn.

clue.text: A faded sign by the pond: ‘Feed the gold, and the gold will feed you.’

goldkoi.title: Golden Hours

moonfish.rumor: A sailor says a round silver fish glows under the moon off Island One.

clue.text: A fishing log with a moon drawn on the last page.

moonfish.title: Moonlit

marlin.rumor: Something with a sword for a nose cruises past the Far Isle on clear summer days.

clue.text: A castaway shows you a bill he found on the beach.

marlin.title: Blue Blur

hammerhead.rumor: The pirates never swim at dusk. Ask yourself why.

clue.text: A torn page: ‘the hammer comes when the sun goes red’.

hammerhead.title: Dusk Hammer

wrasse.rumor: A diver talks of a huge blue fish with a bump on its brow, watching the wreck.

clue.text: Scratch marks on a crate: a fish with a bump on its head.

wrasse.title: Reef King

greenland.rumor: The old ones say something older than the village sleeps under the ice.

clue.text: An elder’s drawing of a long grey shape beneath an ice hole.

greenland.title: Ice Elder

mola.rumor: A fisherman says a fish like a swimming head drifts by the rock in the fog.

clue.text: A damp postcard of a huge round fish.

mola.title: Fog Drifter

oarfish.rumor: A silver ribbon the length of a boat, they say, glides in at dusk when the fog comes.

clue.text: A carved serpent on the dock wall, with fins down its back.

oarfish.title: Sea Serpent

sailfish.rumor: At first light a fish with a fan on its back herds sardines under the red cliffs.

clue.text: A feather-light fin sail caught in the rocks.

sailfish.title: First Light

tarpon.rumor: In the night rain, something silver rolls and gulps air by the temple steps.

clue.text: A temple keeper holds up a scale as big as a coin.

tarpon.title: Silver King
